title: Action Graph
description: PERD §24 and SoT §43.9: pack data. Nodes are registered capabilities and evidence reads; edges are dependencies with a condition. Planner cannot create a node at runtime (INV-18). The PERD lists the node and edge fields but gives no value type for on_unknown, on_failure, recovery_ref or escalation_ref; the smallest safe types are chosen here from PERD §30.1 and §30.2 (open decision recorded in the T2 report). packcheck (REQ-AG-001) checks every reference, the types of every predicate, acyclicity, and that every WRITE node has both references. v2 (PCK-04; PERD v1.19 REQ-AG-001 as amended by DEC-2026-10-31 D9): adds the required `roots` list, the declared roots that packcheck exempts from the incoming-edge rule; packcheck also requires every node to have a postcondition, every WRITE node a precondition, and a graph of more than one node to be connected.

applies_when.description: When the Planner selects this graph: G1 always, G2 on ESCALATE with a resolved target, G3 when policy requires a complaint reference (PERD §24).

roots.description: The declared roots (PERD REQ-AG-001): the nodes the planner may start from. Every other node needs at least one incoming edge. Each names a node of this graph (checked by packcheck).

recovery_ref.description: One of the capability's own recovery strategies (descriptor recovery[]); null for a node that does not write.

escalation_ref.description: Where an unrecoverable node goes (PERD §30.2): a case or a handoff; null for a node that does not write.

RecoveryAction.description: PERD §30.1 recovery types 1, 2, 3 and 5. Compensation (type 4) is not available in the POC.
